headline: Schlein on Wealth Tax | I'm in Favor of a Tax on the Super Rich; AVS Says Yes, Conte Has Doubts
summary: Italy's centre-left opposition is split over a proposed tax on large fortunes, with the Democratic Party leader in favour and the Five Star Movement leader expressing doubts.
why: Wealth tax proposals affect fiscal policy and investor expectations about tax treatment of high-net-worth individuals.
